g.text: SD01 - GUI voice command (UC01; F02-F04, F09)
Preconditions: GUI is composed; controller.start() registered
the controller and selected view as game observers.
Native initialization and capture run on the voice worker.
[active voice session; example changed partial is "right"]
Ignore old epochs, superseded utterances and duplicate text.
The accepted callback posts work to the application loop.
Freeze context for this utterance, including lastMovement.
Two active calls and one latest pending input; deadline includes waiting.
No map, position, goal or game access.
SD02: validate freshness/schema, plan and execute Java commands.
Increment the captured session's utterance counter.
The loop above shows a current, active, successful request.
Stale decisions do not mutate controls; invalid current decisions fail closed.
GUI render coalesces updates onto the JavaFX thread; ticks continue independently.
[current provider failure, deadline, or voice failure]
Provider completion checks isCurrent(update) before failCurrent(message).
Voice must be explicitly restarted after a failure; SD05 shows reset mechanics.
